sources.title: google/gemma-2-2b-it model card
sources.evidence: Exact instruction-tuned repository identifies Google, Gemma license, open weights, decoder-only text-to-text models and native bfloat16 export. Includes the exact -it model identifier and user/model chat template. Reopened October 27, 2026: no separately defined numerical active count is supplied.

sources.title: Smaller, Safer, More Transparent: Advancing Responsible AI with Gemma
sources.evidence: July 31, 2024 announcement introduces Gemma 2 2B and states weights can be downloaded starting today. Its release-collection link includes the exact instruction-tuned variant.

sources.title: Official Gemma 2 2B Release collection
sources.evidence: Linked from the dated launch announcement; labels this the 2.6B-parameter version and lists google/gemma-2-2b-it in Transformers format separately from the base and original PyTorch variants.

sources.title: Pinned official instruction-tuned checkpoint metadata
sources.publisher: Hugging Face metadata for Google weights
sources.evidence: Revision 299a8560bedf22ed1c72a8a11e7dce4a7f9f51f8 reports safetensors.parameters.BF16 and safetensors.total both 2614341888. Identifies Gemma2ForCausalLM and the user/assistant chat template. This is repository tensor aggregation, not independently downloaded headers. Fresh direct metadata retrieval October 27, 2026 reconfirmed the same revision and exact BF16 total; no new tensor census or weight download was performed.

sources.title: Official Gemma 2 PyTorch configuration, pinned revision
sources.evidence: get_config_for_2b_v2 uses 26 layers, width 2304, MLP intermediate size 9216, eight query and four KV heads of width 256, four RMSNorm vectors per layer and alternating local/global attention. Defaults include vocabulary 256000, maximum positions 8192, BF16 and quant=False.

sources.title: Official Gemma PyTorch model implementation, pinned revision
sources.evidence: Gemma 2 uses bias-free attention projections, three dense MLP matrices, four learned normalization vectors per layer and a final normalization. Sampling reuses the input embedding. Rotary frequencies are computed buffers; quantization scalers exist only when quant=True.

sources.title: Gemma 2: Improving Open Language Models at a Practical Size
sources.evidence: Describes a decoder-only Transformer, GQA, tied embeddings and 8192-token context. Its 2B table lists 590118912 embedding plus 2024517888 nonembedding parameters using vocabulary 256128, a different vocabulary size from the released implementation. It does not define an active count for this model. Fresh October 27 complete-report parameter review: section 6 explicitly states comparisons use total rather than active parameters. Its instruction-tuning procedure preserves the model architecture; teacher-output distillation does not supply an active-count convention or justify inheriting the larger teacher size.

sources.title: Building a chatbot with Gemma
sources.evidence: Loads gemma2_instruct_2b_en, states it has 2.6 billion trainable parameters and explains that the 2B name excludes the embedding layer. Reopened October 27, 2026; the 2.6B figure remains a trainable total and 2B a non-embedding naming convention, not a separately stated active count.

sources.title: Gemma Terms of Use
sources.evidence: The official model card links these terms; the terms appendix explicitly includes Gemma 2.

sources.title: Agentic AI with Gemma 2, official pinned cookbook notebook
sources.evidence: Cell 7 selects gemma2_instruct_2b_en. Cell 10 says Gemma 2 lacks built-in function calling and presents few-shot prompting to approximate agentic behavior. Later examples generate textual Action requests for the application to interpret; the claim concerns built-in support, not inability to produce prompted calls.

sources.title: Beyond the Chatbot: Agentic AI with Gemma
sources.evidence: February 13, 2025 article links the notebook, explicitly includes 2B, describes limited built-in function calling and demonstrates ReAct prompting to obtain textual function requests.

sources.title: Official checkpoint first-shard header access attempt
sources.evidence: HTTP Range bytes=0-7 returned 401 Unauthorized. Raw config, index and tokenizer requests also returned 401. No weight payload or tensor header was downloaded; accessible repository metadata was reconciled with official implementation instead.

sources.title: Gemma 2 model card
sources.evidence: Fresh October 27 current-card check includes the exact 2B variant and its pre-trained/instruction-tuned family. It gives nominal model sizes and benchmark comparisons, with no independently labeled numerical active-parameter specification.

sources.title: Gemma 3 Technical Report
sources.evidence: Fresh October 27 full-text later-disclosure check, including Gemma 2 2B comparison tables. The report provides nominal total sizes and performance comparisons, not a numerical active count for the older 2B instruction-tuned model. No Gemma 3 sibling size is transferred.

sources.title: Gemma 4 Technical Report
sources.evidence: Fresh October 27 full-text later-disclosure review. The report separately defines activated parameters for its new MoE model and effective sizes for PLE models; neither applies to Gemma 2 2B IT. No retrospective active count for this exact model appears.

sources.title: Generalist large language models in a specialized world: Evidence from the Italian national medical education pathway
sources.publisher: Buonocore et al., PLOS Digital Health
sources.evidence: Fresh exact-model active-count search found Table 2 listing Gemma 2 2B IT as 2 under Active Params. Read the publisher article, PDF tables and reference 19. Table 1 explicitly switches to active counting for MoE, while the Gemma citation is the original Google report that specifies total-based comparisons. The paper supplies no Gemma-specific active convention or measurement; it also lists Mixtral 8x7B as 7 active despite citing the 13B-active Mixtral report. This nominal-size reuse is not accepted as a separately verified Google active count.

sources.title: Qwen3 Technical Report — activated-parameter comparisons
sources.evidence: Fresh October 27 review of later comparison tables with explicit activated-parameter rows. They include other Gemma generations and sizes, but no exact Gemma 2 2B IT row. Neither those rows nor a generic dense-model convention is transferred to this model.

name.note: The exact repository is the instruction-tuned 2B variant, distinct from the base model and other Gemma generations.

developer.note: Google is the named model author and release publisher.

family.note: Gemma 2 belongs to the Gemma model family.

release_date.note: Dated first-party announcement states weights are available starting today and links a collection containing this IT variant. Earlier repository creation/upload timestamps do not establish public availability.

open_weights.note: Google releases downloadable instruction-tuned weights under Gemma terms; file downloads require acceptance of the usage terms.

license.note: The model card identifies the Gemma license and links the applicable terms.

parameters_b.note: Complete unique learned count: 256000*2304 + 26*(14155776 attention + 63700992 MLP + 9216 normalization) + 2304 final normalization = 2614341888. The tied output embedding is counted once; computed RoPE buffers and optional quantization scalers are excluded. This exactly matches official BF16 checkpoint metadata. The paper instead sums to 2614636800 using 256128 vocabulary rows, 294912 more (128*2304). Direct header inspection was blocked by gating; this is implementation-derived and metadata-cross-checked. Fresh October 27 re-audit reconfirmed the pinned metadata and original published conventions; retain this supported exact released-checkpoint total rather than replacing it with the nominal 2B name or the teacher size.

active_parameters_b.note: Fresh October 27 exact-model active/activated-count searches and original/later comparison checks found no supported separate active count. Google explicitly identifies 2B as excluding embeddings and states its original comparisons use total parameters. The PLOS 2B active-column lead reuses nominal sizes and gives no Gemma-specific active convention; its cited Google source does not substantiate that label. Later activated-parameter tables contain no exact row. Neither total nor non-embedding size is copied into active.

architecture.note: Dense decoder-only Transformer with 26 layers, GQA and alternating 4096-token local and 8192-token global attention; the implementation has ordinary dense MLPs and no expert routing.

context_window.note: Official configuration maximum positions and paper global attention span are 8192. The 4096 local sliding window is not the full context limit.

modalities.note: The exact model card documents text input and generated text output.

reasoning.note: Sources discuss reasoning tasks and ordinary instruction tuning but do not establish a dedicated reasoning mode or an explicit negative capability declaration for this checkpoint. The unsupported baseline false is cleared.

tool_call.note: The exact 2B IT cookbook states that built-in function calling is absent, then demonstrates prompted ReAct calls interpreted by the application. The catalog flag is not defined solely as a native protocol, so this mixed evidence does not support a categorical false for its broader capability meaning. Retain the native-versus-prompted distinction and clear the baseline false.

description.value: Instruction-tuned Gemma 2 text-generation model from Google, with open weights and an 8,192-token context window.
description.note: Plain description identifies the IT variant, developer, release format and supported context without qualitative performance claims.

patch.description: Instruction-tuned Gemma 2 text-generation model from Google, with open weights and an 8,192-token context window.
patch.notes: The 2B name excludes embeddings; the released BF16 checkpoint contains 2.614341888B unique learned parameters. Google does not separately publish an active count in the reviewed sources. Google documents no built-in function calling but demonstrates prompted ReAct calls; the broader tool capability remains unverified.

summary: October 27 parameter re-audit reconfirms the released-checkpoint total of 2.614341888B from freshly retrieved pinned BF16 metadata, consistent with the existing implementation reconciliation. Active parameters remain explicitly null after exact-model searches, original Google documentation and later Gemma/Qwen comparison checks. Traced a 2B active-column claim in independent medical-evaluation research to nominal-size reuse rather than a separately supported active specification. No weight shards or repeated tensor census; unrelated field assessments and corrections preserved.
